request: Pull the College Scorecard 'Most Recent Cohorts (Institution-Level)' bulk CSV from the U.S. Department of Education public download bucket, slice to the 23 columns relevant for a comparison demo (cost, completion, debt, earnings, admission rate, geography), and publish to 'Prep Agent / 07 - College Outcomes' on Tableau Server for education analysts.

sources.name: College Scorecard Most Recent Cohorts
sources.description: U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard 'Most Recent Cohorts (Institution-Level)' bulk download. ZIP-wrapped CSV, ~6300 rows, 3308 columns. We slice to 23 relevant columns for a cost-completion-earnings comparison demo. Public, keyless. Refresh: monthly (data publisher updates roughly weekly).

outputs.name: College Scorecard Outcomes
outputs.description: U.S. College Scorecard 'Most Recent Cohorts' institution-level outcomes (~6300 schools) with the 23 demo-relevant columns: UNITID (IPEDS ID), INSTNM (school name), CITY, STABBR (state), ZIP, PREDDEG (predominant degree: 0-4), HIGHDEG (highest degree: 0-4), CONTROL (1=Public, 2=Private nonprofit, 3=Private for-profit), LOCALE (Carnegie 11-43), LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ADM_RATE (admission rate), UGDS (undergraduate enrollment), COSTT4_A (avg attendance cost), TUITIONFEE_IN/OUT (in/out-state tuition), C150_4 / C150_L4 (4-yr / less-than-4-yr completion rate at 150% time), COMPL_RPY_3YR_RT (3-yr repayment rate among completers), GRAD_DEBT_MDN (median debt at completion), MN_EARN_WNE_P10 / MD_EARN_WNE_P10 (mean / median earnings 10 yrs after entry). Source: U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard public bulk download. Refresh: monthly.
